references.text: The same construction with pillars and bases of copper used in the structure of the tabernacle
Pillars with hooks of silver are also mentioned in connection with the curtain of the tabernacle
Parallel description of the north side of the courtyard with the same number of pillars and bases
All the pillars around the courtyard had bands of silver and hooks of silver
The fulfillment of the instructions regarding pillars with hooks and bars
The actual execution of the courtyard's pillars with bases of copper and hooks of silver
Description of how the bases of the pillars were of copper, while the hooks and bands were of silver
The execution of the command in 27:10 confirms obedience and the completion of the sanctuary's construction.
Shows consistent material theology (bronze/silver) across different parts of the sanctuary.
Highlights the symmetry and unity of the sanctuary's construction by repeating the specifications for another side.
Emphasizes the unity of the sanctuary by showing that the material requirements apply regardless of direction.
